title: Copilot Studio: service principal as owner of workflows
summary: The briefing passes: its roadmap facts, workflow billing statements and application-user API match the sources checked. Service-principal ownership remains explicitly a roadmap plan rather than documented workflow behaviour. Minor corrections concern an omitted pane heading and two checklist controls missing from the table.

claims.where: controls[0].ui and controls[0].api; Governance controls; Open questions
claims.claim: No tenant or environment switch or corresponding API controlling service principal workflow ownership is documented.
claims.quote: Searched: Copilot Studio workflow service principal owner switch tenant environment API Dataverse entity reference pac admin PowerShell. Read workflows overview, FAQ, designer; CLI and inventory results give agent reassignment or resource metadata, not this switch.

claims.claim: The application-user UI route ends at + New app user > + Add an app after Manage > Environments > environment > Settings > Users + permissions > Application users.
claims.quote: Select + New app user to open the Create a new app user pane. Select + Add an app to choose the registered Microsoft Entra application that was created for the selected user, and then select Add.
claims.fix: Set the path to 'Manage > Environments > environment > Settings > Users + permissions > Application users > + New app user > Create a new app user > + Add an app'. This restores the omitted pane heading without changing the documented route.
